items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: To the Black Hawk to see the Bob Crosby band, which I’d never seen live. And he knew, God I loved this band, I listened every night on the radio.

ctx.x: To the Black Hawk to see the Bob Crosby band, which I’d never seen live. And he knew, God I loved this band, I listened every night on the radio.
He was probably pretty proud of you at that time. Neat.
